newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian Saudi bank raising capital.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian Saudi bank raising capital.

text.p: Egyptian Saudi Finance Bank said on Wednesday it was proposing to increase its authorised and paid-in capital to 300 million pounds ($88 million) from 100 million pounds at present.
The board has called an extraordinary meeting of shareholders for July 5 to approve the increase in authorised capital to 300 million.

It also wants the shareholders to give the board authority to "take all executive measures necessary to raise the extra capital in stages until it reaches the authorised amount and to fix the rules for subscription at each stage", a statement said.
